mechanic: momentum side-scroll rover — a rover auto-drives a rolling regolith line while you manage MOMENTUM rather than a trigger: tap to hop crater-gaps and launch off ramps, hold throttle to boost (it overheats and forces a cooldown), and brake to let a hazard slide past; there are NO guns — instead a front scoop MAGNET-GRABS falling debris, drifting drones and ore into a combo you cash at stage beacons, and a timed shield-pulse ricochets incoming bombs; chain clean air-time and grabs for a rising multiplier; escalating terrain, denser skies and tighter gaps across marked stages with lives
theme: synthwave lunar rally — a chrome buggy kicks neon dust and catches big air over cratered magenta regolith, ore-sparks arcing into its scoop, parallax mesas and a drone-swept sky under a low bloom-lit sun
seo_target: lunar rover stunt rally game unblocked
